upstream.name: sqlite/sqlite
upstream.architecture: SQLite database file format, b-tree pages, records, varints, journaling, SQL engine, extensions, and TCL/C regression harnesses.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow blobless GitHub mirror clone at .upstream-cache/libsqlite; counted with git ls-tree without hydrating broad blobs.

runnerStatus.reason: The upstream runner was inventoried but not executed in this modest lane run: SQLite's documented test flow requires configuring/building testfixture/sqlite3 with Tcl development libraries, then running testrunner.tcl suites such as full/all that cover thousands of TCL scripts and many permutations. The defensible denominator here is the cloned static file/script inventory, not upstream pass parity.

benchmarkDenominator.warning: This denominator counts upstream test files, helper programs, and declared suites, not individual do_test assertions. PHP progress is local mapped behavior only.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native SQLite database header parser, SQLite varint decoder, and b-tree page header parser for schema/root pages.

wordpressScenario: SQLite fallback/read-write inspection tooling for WordPress hosts where the SQLite extension is unavailable.
nextTask: Parse table leaf cells on the schema root page and decode sqlite_schema records needed to locate WordPress tables such as wp_options.
